blog_title: How to Check T-Shirt GSM at Home — 220 GSM vs 160 GSM Fraud Exposed for Bulk Buyers
caption:
₹60,000 batch ruined in one rainstorm. Colour bled everywhere. 😬

Dark colours like navy, royal blue & maroon bleed if colour fastness is below 3. We learned this the hard way — 500 DTF-printed tees, wasted.

Here's the 2-minute test: rub a wet white cloth on fabric 10 times. If colour transfers, reject the batch.

Save this post before your next bulk order 👇
